text.tspan: People living with tuberculosis by drug susceptibilityWorld
Estimated number of people living with tuberculosis, broken down by drug susceptibility level.
Data source: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025)
Note: Data includes only tuberculosis cases in HIV-negative people. Tuberculosis cases among people with HIV are classified under HIV/AIDS
